issue_context.title: Make it easier to define enum settings
issue_context.body: We have a few settings that accept a fixed set of string values, like `index.routing.allocation.enable` and `index.translog.durability`. It could be nice to provide a built-in way of creating these 'enum settings', in line with other factory methods we have like `boolSetting`. This would create a standard, robust way to validate + parse these settings, instead of relying on 'switch' statements as we currently do in some places.

review_comments: I wasn't sure wether or not to add all the signatures, which I copied from `boolSetting`. Also wasn't sure about adding comments. The added functionality seems straightforward and use is similar to f.e. `boolSetting`

Some basic javadocs would be appreciated. While we are severely lacking them currently, we try to add them with new stuff when possible. Regarding multiple variants: less is better. So I would just add the minimum variants necessary for the existing enum use cases. We can always add more later, but we have a large problem of seldom used methods/ctors, when a single method/ctor would suffice.
